name: Animated Tag Previews
description: Create cropped VP9 WebM previews from Cove videos and use them as optional animated tag media.
author: MidnightRider

externalDependencies.name: FFmpeg with VP9 encoding
externalDependencies.description: Encodes bounded, muted VP9 WebM tag previews. The libvpx-vp9 encoder must be available.
externalDependencies.installHint: Install an FFmpeg build containing libvpx-vp9 or configure Cove's FFmpeg path.

externalDependencies.name: FFprobe
externalDependencies.description: Probes source and generated media before a preview is published.
externalDependencies.installHint: Install FFprobe beside FFmpeg or configure Cove's FFprobe path.

tutorialTopics.title: Animated Tag Previews
tutorialTopics.description: Set up, generate, and manage animated media for tags.

slides.title: Check the encoder
slides.caption: Cove normally manages FFmpeg and FFprobe for you.
slides.bodyMarkdown: Open the extension health view before your first encode. Both tools must be available, and FFmpeg must report the `libvpx-vp9` encoder. Tool paths stay on the server and are never sent to the browser.
points: Install or configure FFmpeg and FFprobe
Confirm VP9 support in extension health
Keep source media readable by Cove

slides.title: Create a preview
slides.caption: Use the preview action on a video player.
slides.bodyMarkdown: Pause on a useful moment, open Animated Tag Preview, position the configured crop, choose a readable tag, and start the job. Cove validates access again on the server and publishes the result only after the new WebM has been stored successfully.
points: Drag or use keyboard and numeric crop controls
Choose the canonical tag, not a typed tag name
Follow or cancel the background job from Cove

slides.title: Playback and fallback
slides.caption: The normal tag image remains the source of truth.
slides.bodyMarkdown: Supported tag cards and heroes can play the muted looping WebM. Cove keeps the ordinary tag image as poster and fallback. Reduced-motion preferences, unsupported surfaces, media errors, and missing previews all render the static image.
points: Previews load lazily near the viewport

slides.title: Keep or remove generated media
slides.caption: Generated files are data, not extension binaries.
slides.bodyMarkdown: Disabling or upgrading the extension preserves preview mappings and Cove-managed blobs. Uninstall also preserves generated data by default. Delete an individual preview from the extension before uninstalling when it should be removed, and use the explicit orphan-cleanup dry run before approving bulk deletion.
points: Disable hides UI without deleting previews
Upgrade replaces code without replacing user data
Deletion and orphan cleanup are explicit operations
